title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - PlannedIncidence
description: Planned traffic incidence, can be recurrent or not (edinttrafico:PlannedIncidence, subclass of edinttrafico:Incidence and geosparql:Feature). Carries Incidence's own base properties (incidenceInSection, incidenceType, startDate, endDate, incidenceAttachment, numDirections) plus its own (expectedEndDate, isRecurrent, recurrence). Formerly excluded as part of an external-ontology traffic branch; now natively defined as of source ontology v0.2.1.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PlannedIncidence'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

incidenceInSection.description: Relationship. The StreetSection where the incidence takes place (edinttrafico:incidenceInSection).

incidenceType.description: Relationship. Type of incidence. The source ontology does not publish a controlled vocabulary for this yet (unlike e.g. Facility.infrastructureType); kept as a generic Relationship.

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The start date and time of the incidence (edinttrafico:startDate, schema:startDate).

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The end date and time of the incidence (edinttrafico:endDate, schema:endDate).

incidenceAttachment.description: Property. A document where more information about the incidence can be found (edinttrafico:incidenceAttachment).

numDirections.description: Property. Number of directions of traffic affected (edinttrafico:numDirections).

expectedEndDate.description: Property. The expected end date and time of a planned incidence (edinttrafico:expectedEndDate).

isRecurrent.description: Property. Whether the planned incidence is recurrent or not (edinttrafico:isRecurrent).

recurrence.description: Property. Description of the recurrence pattern, e.g. an iCalendar RRULE or free text (edinttrafico:recurrence). The source ontology does not constrain the format.
